description_en: Retrieves tags of a live stream media asset
kebab_example: aliyun ice get-stream-tag-list --search-lib-name Stream_xxx --namespace name-1 --media-id 000000b48fb04483915d4f2cd8000000 --start-time 2025-04-23T02:26:00Z --end-time 2017-12-22T08:00:00Z --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --sort-by StartTime:Asc --next-token 000073f33c91-d59383e8280b0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetStreamTagList

parameters.help_en: The name of the search library
parameters.name: search_lib_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the media asset
parameters.name: media_id

parameters.help_en: The start of the query time range, based on the tagging timestamp. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: StartTime（打标时间）的开始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the query time range, based on the tagging timestamp. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: StartTime（打标时间）的结束时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order for the results. Valid values:

StartTime:Desc (default): Sort by creation time in descending order.

StartTime:Asc: Sort by creation time in ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
查询结果排序。取值：

StartTime:Desc（默认值）：按创建时间倒序。
StartTime:Asc：按创建时间升序
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results
parameters.name: next_token

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results

EndTime.description_en: The end time. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

StartTime.description_en: The start time. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：
true： 成功
false：失败

Total.description_en: The total number of entries that are returned
